title: Euro 2012: Germany's Joachim Löw names his 23-man ...
content: Germany' Holger Badstuber, left, Toni Kroos and Thomas Müller enjoy a time-out at their Euro 2012 training camp in Tourrettes, SE France. # Euro 2012: Germany's Joachim Löw names his 23-man squad. Cacau, Marc-Andre ter Stegen, Sven Bender and Julian Draxler have all been left out of Joachim Löw's 23-man selection for Euro 2012. The head coach, who took a 27-man squad into training camps in Sardinia and France, will explain his choices on Tuesday, when he will be working with his final group in the build-up to their first match of the tournament, against Portugal on 9 June. "It was my big goal after the World Cup in South Africa [in 2010] also to be part of Euro 2012 with the Germany national team," Cacau said. Like the younger players, I am also disappointed, but I still feel part of this team and wish them from the bottom of my heart that they play a great European Championship.".

title: Marc-André ter Stegen - Wikipedia
content: In this German name, the surname is  *ter Stegen*, not  *Stegen*. | Ter Stegen with Barcelona in 2024 |. **Marc-André ter Stegen** (German pronunciation:  ⓘ; born 30 April 1992) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper "Goalkeeper (association football)") for La Liga club Barcelona and the Germany national team. After four seasons in the Bundesliga with Borussia Mönchengladbach, making 108 league appearances, Ter Stegen joined Barcelona for €12 million in 2014. He won the treble "Treble (association football)") in his first season in Spain, playing for Barcelona in Copa del Rey and UEFA Champions League. He was part of the German squads that reached the semi-finals of UEFA Euro 2016 and won the 2017 FIFA Confederations Cup, and was also a member of the German side that took part at the 2018 FIFA World Cup, 2022 FIFA World Cup and UEFA Euro 2024. In the first half of the 2010–11 season, he established himself as the star of their reserve team and was frequently seen on the first-team bench.
